sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:

The game's controls are straightforward and easy to use, making it accessible to players of all ages and skill levels. The game can be played using a mouse, keyboard, or touch controls, which is a great feature for players who prefer to play on different devices.
